entities.name: Chulane
entities.description: A human druid of Eldraine whose storytelling conveys secret wisdom, who warned of the invasion and is believed to have survived it.

entities.name: Rankle
entities.description: Faerie who followed Chulane intending to rob him.

entities.name: Queen Ayara
entities.description: Queen of Locthwain, whom Chulane warned.

entities.name: Locthwain
entities.description: The court and castle where the Queen rules.

events.summary: Chulane tried to warn villagers that something terrible would come from the bruised sky, but they called him a fool and chased him away with rocks.
events.quote: He was called a fool, and youths began to throw rocks at him

events.summary: Chulane decided to warn Queen Ayara; Rankle followed to rob him but was distracted by Locthwain Castle, and Chulane guarded his gold.
events.quote: Chulane noticed him and guarded his gold.

events.summary: Chulane told the Queen the skies would open and horrors rain out, and she beckoned him into her carriage to explain more.
events.quote: he approached and requested an audience to warn her

events.summary: Chulane is believed to have survived the Invasion.
events.quote: Chulane is believed to have survived the Invasion.
